text:
alex: Nightly CI red for the integration suite hitting Hosted API. Failing tests are mostly streaming + tool-call paths, plus a couple of auth 401s on shard-17. Build: https://ci.internal/runs/12345 :grimacing:

maria: ugh. any obvious recent changes? proxy/auth stuff merged this morning?

alex: yep merged a small auth header normalize patch (PR #8342) and a streaming connection tweak earlier. failures started ~ 05:43 UTC. attaching failing log snippet below.

alex: ```
ERROR test_integration_stream_toolcall.py::test_tool_call_flow - AssertionError: expected tool response, got 503
...
Hosted API response: 503 Service Unavailable
headers: {"x-request-id": "rq_abc123", "retry-after": "2"}
```

dan: can we rerun the failing shards first (17 + 3)? if green then probably transient. if still red we should bisect.

alex: requesting rerun for shard-17 and shard-3 now — pinging @ci-bot to schedule parallel reruns.

ci-bot: Scheduled reruns: run/12345#shard-17, run/12345#shard-3. ETA ~5m. Logs will post here when done. :gear:

priya: also saw a couple of auth 401s in the trace. snippet from curl used by tests:

priya: ```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" https://hosted.api.redwood/v1/stream
* Server auth: Bearer header sent
< HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
< www-authenticate: Bearer realm=\"redwood\", error=\"invalid_token\"
```

maria: hmm token looks valid locally. could be our kid rotation logic (kid mismatch) or a token caching layer returning stale keys. @sre-jen any rate-limit or partial outage in hosted region-us-west-2?

sre-jen: no active incident, but saw elevated 5xxs around 05:40-05:50 in us-west-2 (spike ~ 0.8% of requests). Could be a short backend pool recycle. I'll check load balancer logs for rq_abc123.

dan: if reruns stay red, let's try a targeted bisect between commits 5f2 and c8a (those bracket the auth-normalize PR). I'll prepare bisect job but want confirmation first.

alex: reruns finished: shard-3 -> green, shard-17 -> still red. logs attached: https://ci.internal/runs/12345/shard-17/log

alex: shard-17 shows repeated toolcall 503s with same x-request-id prefix. also several 401s for a test that asserts streaming handshake success.

priya: grabbing local repro script to hit the same endpoint with same token/headers. will try to repro against staging & hosted.

maria: marking this for bisect if priya repros or shard-17 stays red after infra confirms backend spike. Dan, please stand by to start bisect.

sre-jen: LB logs show backend pool drain at 05:41 for instances serving that tenant — likely the spike. I've reopened the pool and watching latency. will post update in 10m.

alex: thanks. action items: (1) priya - try quick repro + post curl logs, (2) dan - prepare bisect job but don't run yet, (3) jen - confirm LB/instance state. I'll keep thread updated and escalate if shard-17 doesn't clear. :eyes:
